# War Scroll Column 15 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 15 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**15:1** For this is the time of distress for Israel, and the appointed time of war against all the nations. For the lot of God there shall be

**15:2** eternal redemption, and annihilation for all the lot of Belial. There shall be great terror among

**15:3** the sons of Japheth, and Assyria shall fall with none to help. The dominion of the Kittim shall come to an end,

**15:4** that wickedness may be brought low without remnant, and there shall be no survivor among the Sons of Darkness.

**15:5** [...] The Sons of Righteousness shall shine to all the ends of the earth, growing ever brighter until

**15:6** all the appointed times of darkness are brought to completion. In the appointed time of God, His exalted greatness shall shine

**15:7** for all the eternal ages, bringing peace and blessing, glory and joy, and length of days for all the Sons of Light. On the day

**15:8** when the Kittim fall, there shall be battle and fierce destruction before the God of Israel. For that is the day

**15:9** appointed by Him from of old for the war of annihilation against the Sons of Darkness. On that day the congregation of the angels

**15:10** and the assembly of men shall engage together in great destruction. The Sons of Light and the lot of Darkness shall fight together

**15:11** [...] with the might of God, amid the roar of a great multitude and the war cry of angels and men on the day of calamity.

**15:12** It shall be a time of tri[bulation for the peo]ple redeemed by God. Of all their tribulations, none shall compare to this,

**15:13** from its onset until eternal redemption is accomplished. On the day of their battle against the Kittim,

**15:14** they shall go forth to great destruction in battle. [...] Three lots the Sons of Light shall stand firm to strike down

**15:15** wickedness, and three lots Belial shall strengthen himself to repel the lot of [...] The infantry battalions

**15:16** shall cause the heart to melt, [...] but the might of God shall strengthen the he[art of the Sons of Light.] In the seventh lot

**15:17** the great hand of God shall subdue [Belial and all] the angels of his dominion and all the men of [his lot.]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 15 is the exhortation before the final battle, with significant lacunae. "Time of distress" adopted (LOGOS) over "time of trouble" (EMET) and "hour of crisis" (PNEUMA). "Sons of Japheth" preserved (EMET/LOGOS) over "descendants of Japheth" (PNEUMA). The seven-lot battle structure (15:14-17) rendered with "lots" (EMET/LOGOS) rather than "rounds" (PNEUMA). "Congregation of the angels" retained over "heaven's army" (PNEUMA). Genuine lacunae preserved with [...]. 17 disagreements logged.*
